title: auto-research-hypotheses@1 — the /learn cross-run hypothesis tracker (dev/learning/hypotheses.json)
description: One hypothesis per RATIFIED /learn proposal. Written ONLY through bin/learn_hypotheses.py (schema-validated, atomic). Lifecycle: ratified-pending-build -> built(commit) -> deployed -> closed-*; a verdict other than 'unmeasurable' requires status=deployed (the cache-drift lesson: a run on pre-change code cannot test the change). Verdict consequences (enforced by the /learn methodology, not this schema): helped -> Keep-list + settled; no-effect twice -> auto-open a revert/simplification proposal; hurt -> auto-open a revert proposal, never silent; unmeasurable twice -> status untracked and the brief must say so.

statement.description: the change, in one plain sentence

expected_signal.description: the RATIFIED (owner-edited) observable: next run should show X — run-relative, categorical, falsifiable

evidence.description: verbatim anchor from the checked run
